把品牌、产品、法务和媒体意见先收集到内部表，再由一位负责人去重并解决冲突。建议每:
Collect brand, product, legal and media comments internally, then have one owner deduplicate and resolve conflicts. Each note should include a timecode, issue type, original requirement, requested action and acceptance condition. “At 00:18 the product name is wrong; replace it with the approved name” is actionable, while “make it feel more premium” has no acceptance condition. Send one list per round and identify which requests belong to agreed scope.

Review capacity needs a limit. If 12 creators submit rough cuts on one day while the team can fully review only four per day, stagger delivery or add reviewers. A two-business-day first response and one day for factual correction can be planning inputs, but actual timing should come from team capacity and launch date.
先生成 10 位候选并逐条审核。记录身份错误、链接失效、内容不相关、受众未经验证:
Generate 10 candidates first and review every record. Log identity errors, broken links, irrelevant content, unverified audience claims and inference presented as fact. If three of 10 records contain a blocking problem, pause scaling and correct the rules; 3/10 only demonstrates how to express a trigger, and the team should set its own standard by task risk.

YouTube content analytics interprets views, average view duration and audience in the context of specific content and time windows; AI research should likewise cite original content rather than paraphrase a profile bio. Creator-economy growth described by IAB may increase research volume, but faster processing is not a reason to lower the evidence standard.
每位候选至少保存数据日期、原始截图或链接、3 条受众匹配证据、1 个主要风险和待:
For each candidate, save the data date, original screenshot or link, three audience-fit signals, one main risk and open questions. Another reviewer should be able to inspect the same material and reach a similar conclusion.

QuickKOL can keep audience and content evidence in one candidate record and flag stale or inconsistent definitions. Write the conclusion as confirmed, inferred or unknown instead of storing only a score.
需要详细演示时，可优先寻找能够解释复杂步骤的创作者；需要大范围认知时，再增加具备:
For detailed demonstrations, prioritize creators who can explain complex steps. Add creators with stable reach when the campaign needs broad awareness. Nano creators can produce strong assets, while macro creators may be a poor fit for a specialist product.

Write each role as a testable deliverable, such as “three creators demonstrate real use” or “one creator supports the launch and provides brand-partner access.”
先按市场、平台、格式和合作任务分组，再按使用权、付费放大与制作复杂度检查范围。品:
Group by market, platform, format and content job, then check usage rights, paid amplification and production complexity. Twenty comparable brand partnerships usually guide budgeting better than an industry average with an unknown sample structure.

A sample smaller than 10 can still provide evidence, but show the count and avoid overly precise percentiles.
平均数容易被一次爆款或失败放大。把每组结果按中位数、25%–75% 区间、最高值:
A mean is easily distorted by one breakout or failed post. Show the median, 25th–75th percentile range, highest and lowest results, with reasons for clear outliers.

If one of 12 posts receives eight times the views because of a trend, it can remain a case study without raising the minimum assumption for the next campaign.
可以补充寄样时间、发布窗口、预算状态或一个具体内容参考，并重申只需要对方确认兴趣:
Add shipping timing, publication window, budget status or one specific content reference, and repeat that the creator only needs to confirm interest and availability. Do not paste the full original message again.

A sample operating interval is three to five business days, but this is not a universal rule. When timing is tight, state the decision date in the original message.
品牌认知、产品试用、内容生产和直接转化需要不同的成本结构。先确定内容数量、市场、:
Awareness, product trial, asset production and direct response require different cost structures. Define content quantity, market, timing, rights and measurement before choosing creator count.

The budget should show what changes when total spend falls by 20% or rises by 20%, instead of presenting only one total.
好的达人研究提示词不是“帮我找 50 个合适达人”，而是明确 Campaign: A useful creator-research prompt does not say “find 50 good creators.” It defines the campaign job, market and platform, requirements, allowed sources, evidence required for every recommendation, output fields and stop conditions. Ask AI to separate confirmed facts, content-based inference and unknowns, with an accessible source link for each candidate. Human review owns the final shortlist and external action.
每位候选输出账号、市场、语言、相关内容、3 条匹配证据、主要风险、未知项和建议下:
For every candidate, return profile, market, language, relevant content, three fit signals, main risk, unknowns and next action. When a requirement fails, state why instead of lowering the standard to fill a quota.

Stop for human review when sources conflict, accounts share a name or cited content cannot be opened.
阻断错误会改变收件人、价格、法律权益或对外承诺，应立即暂停对应工作流并复核同批记:
Blocking errors change the recipient, price, legal rights or external commitment and should pause the relevant workflow while the batch is reviewed. High-risk errors affect selection or budget and require a larger sample; medium and low issues can enter a correction queue.

When the same error appears three times, inspect the prompt, mapping or source for systemic failure even if each instance is low impact. Three is an example internal trigger and should reflect actual risk.

每位候选人至少保留主页、相关内容、推荐理由、已确认数据、风险与待确认问题，再补充:
Keep the profile, relevant content, recommendation reason, confirmed evidence, risk and open questions for every candidate. Add the proposed deliverable, timing, budget assumption and backup order.

A usable shortlist is not a collection of 20 handles. It is 20 decisions with a next step. Before outreach, check duplicate contact, obvious brand conflicts, market availability and a named owner for each open question so discovery becomes an operational campaign asset.
提供目标市场、受众、产品事实、预算范围、时间线和必须满足的筛选条件。输出也要具体:
Provide the market, audience, product facts, budget range, timeline and mandatory criteria. Make the output specific too: “30 candidates with relevant content, a recommendation reason and open questions,” rather than “find suitable creators.”

Leave unknown information explicitly unknown instead of inviting the agent to fill gaps as fact. Define stop conditions as well: insufficient evidence, conflicting data, budget exceptions or uncertain contacts should return the workflow to an owner.
把候选分成优先联系、替补和暂缓，而不是强行从 1 排到 100。优先级应综合匹配:
Group creators into priority, backup and hold categories instead of forcing a 1-to-100 rank. Priority should combine fit, evidence completeness, timing risk and budget assumptions.

Size each batch according to the communication capacity the team can actually handle. Sending too many invitations at once creates reply backlogs, slow quote decisions and a poor creator experience.
将证据分为原始内容、平台或品牌公开记录、可信新闻报道、二次转述与未验证说法。只有:
Classify evidence as original content, platform or brand record, reliable reporting, secondary retelling or unverified claim. Only the first three can support a formal conclusion; the last two trigger further review. Save URL, capture date and the market, product or audience affected.

Brand safety also includes commercial-content quality. TikTok’s commercial-content resources describe expectations for creator work, so review disclosure, product claims and presentation together. For each finalist, inspect at least 20 recent posts and all pinned content, then list sponsored work from the previous six to twelve months.

先把“找美妆达人”改写成一组可观察的内容信号，例如敏感肌、成分解释、真实使用过程: Replace “find beauty creators” with observable content signals such as sensitive skin, ingredient explanation, real-use demonstrations, long-form reviews and questions from UK viewers. 第一类是产品与问题词，例如“通勤降噪”“敏感肌屏障”；第二类是场景词，例如开箱、:
The first group describes the product problem, such as commuter noise cancellation or sensitive-skin barriers. The second describes formats such as unboxing, comparison, tutorial or long-term use. The third describes market, language and audience situation. Prepare five to ten terms per group, including local phrasing.

Do not force every condition into one query. Start with two strong signals, then narrow by market, scale and timing. This makes false positives and missed candidates easier to explain.
同一个账号可能跨越多个主题。搜索结果里的单条作品只能说明一次相关性，不能证明长期:
One account may cover several themes. A single relevant search result proves one instance, not sustained fit. Open the profile, review the last 90 days and select at least 10 posts closest to the campaign job.

Record topic, format, product treatment, typical views and audience questions. If relevant work is rare, mark the creator as an occasional fit instead of automatically accepting or rejecting the account.
QuickKOL 中每位候选至少保存一个命中信号、一个代表内容链接、一个风险和一:
For every QuickKOL candidate, save one matching signal, one representative content link, one risk and one open question. A useful reason says “six of the last 10 posts are comparable tutorials,” rather than “the vibe is right.”

Search results change with ranking and time. Preserve the discovery date and evidence link so the team can understand the decision later and update it when content disappears or direction changes.
同时定义品牌冲突、市场不符、近期内容停更、重复联系和明显合规风险。排除必须指向事:
Define brand conflicts, market mismatch, inactivity, duplicate contact and clear compliance risks at the same time. Exclusions need factual support, and “confirmed mismatch” must remain separate from “evidence not found.”

After building the pool, sample 10%–20% of exclusions. If many excluded accounts actually fit the task, change the query or threshold instead of expanding outreach with a flawed filter.
建议先检查最近 90 天，再扩展到 6–12 个月寻找反复模式。对每个平台保存样:
Start with the last 90 days, then expand to six to twelve months to identify repeated patterns. For each platform, record sample size, oldest and newest dates, inaccessible content and whether sponsorships are clearly disclosed.

Separate one incident from a sustained pattern. When a claim comes from a repost or excerpt, return to the original material and full context instead of treating a search snippet as final evidence.
选 10 条与本次格式、主题和时长相近的内容，使用中位观看而不是最高值。若能获得:

Flag breakouts, paid amplification and collaborations. The baseline should create an explainable range rather than a precise prediction.
同一垂类、同一市场且经常联动的达人，受众重叠可能更高；平台、语言或内容场景不同，:
Creators in the same niche, market and collaboration network may overlap more; different platforms, languages or use cases may overlap less. Test 10%, 25% and 40% scenarios, then refine them with campaign history.

These are not industry benchmarks. Label overlap as a planning assumption and explain that it changes combined unique reach, not the quality of an individual creator’s work.
库存不仅是零售价，还包括样品成本、包装、国际运费、税费、替换品和退货处理。按市场:
Inventory cost includes sample cost, packaging, international freight, duties, replacement and returns, not only retail value. Reserve by market and product version instead of one generic backup pool.

For example, shipping to 20 creators with a 10% replacement allowance needs at least 22 units. If only 70% are expected to produce a usable collaboration, the campaign cannot treat 20 shipments as 20 pieces of content.
若只看推荐名单，只能发现误收，不能发现漏选。按市场、语言、规模和内容类型分层，从:

Track false inclusion and false exclusion, classifying causes as search coverage, stale data, rule bias or model interpretation. NIST AI RMF emphasizes governing, measuring and managing risk; these records create a path to improve the workflow.
